binning: panel (a): 70 x 70 bins over delta_x=0--7 cm and delta_y=0--7 cm

display_policy: horizontal two-panel layout in analysis-note panel order
complete independent axes and an independent logarithmic count color scale in each panel
zero-count bins masked; positive in-range counts unchanged
underflow and overflow recorded but not drawn
physics_contract.fit_or_transform: the frozen producer computes energy-weighted mean absolute spatial spreads and fills the two ROOT objects; the output layer applies no rebinning, smoothing, fit, or further transform
physics_contract.sample: Beam-off reconstructed candidates from six March 4, 5, 8, and 11 background files. The merged histograms contain central cores 5, 6, 9, 10 and side cores 4, 7, 8, 11, 13, 14.
selections: panel (a) requires E_tot > 100 MeV; panel (b) has no additional energy selection
central candidates have no plastic-veto requirement; side candidates require count_veto == 0, meaning that all three plastic-veto detectors have no signal
the merged ALL objects include only the four central and six side core groups
variables: delta_x and delta_y: energy-weighted mean absolute spatial spreads multiplied by the 7 cm crystal pitch
E_core: calibrated energy of the reconstructed core crystal [MeV]

public_boundary.notes: Experimental data and generated binary outputs are not distributed. The dedicated long-paper output is retained as historical provenance; the thesis candidate uses the later beam-off output because it applies the author-confirmed Fig. 10 core/veto definition.
